provenance.limitation: These values were hard-coded in a historical conditional cogenesis script. The repository does not contain a complete source passport, covariance, renormalisation prescription, dynamical theta source, CP/washout calculation, entropy history or abundance likelihood. This file exposes that absence rather than inventing provenance.

M_P_MeV.definition: Historical proton-mass input used by the conditional dark-neutron corridor arithmetic

M_E_MeV.definition: Historical electron-mass input used by the conditional dark-neutron corridor arithmetic

M_N_MeV.definition: Historical neutron-mass input used by the conditional dark-neutron corridor arithmetic

S_N_BE9_MeV.definition: Historical Be-9 neutron-separation input used to define the lower corridor edge

BETA_LAT_GeV3.definition: Historical neutron matrix-element input in the conditional portal sensitivity

ALPHA_EM.definition: Historical electromagnetic-coupling input in the conditional portal sensitivity

TAU_N_GEV.definition: Historical neutron-width input in the conditional portal sensitivity

T_STAR_GeV.definition: Historical temperature scale used by the eta-target inversion

M_THETA_GeV.definition: Superseded historical theta-mass identification used only to reproduce the old conditional sensitivity

M_PL_GeV.definition: Historical Planck-scale input used by the eta-target inversion

G_STAR.definition: Historical effective-degrees-of-freedom input used by the eta-target inversion

ETA_TARGET.definition: Historical baryon-asymmetry target supplied to the inversion, not a generated result

OMEGA_RATIO_OBS.definition: Historical Omega_DM/Omega_b comparison ratio used only in the rejected full-ADM arithmetic

OMEGA_RATIO_ERR.definition: Historical comparison uncertainty used only in the rejected full-ADM arithmetic

BR_BOUND_NOW.definition: Historical benchmark used only for a conditional portal-sensitivity comparison
